source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 9 exercise solved (PDF 225-228), MCQ keys from the chapter, numericals worked and checked against the printed answers.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Electrostatics and Current Electricity) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; har numerical step by step hal kiya gaya hai. Mushkil jagah "Wazahat" box aasan alfaaz mein samjhata hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
9.1 Two point charges A and B are separated by 10 m. If the distance between them is reduced to 5m, the force exerted on each:
(Do point charges A aur B 10 m door hain. Faasla 5 m kar diya jaye to har aik par force kitni hogi?)

options.text: decreases to half its original value
increases to twice the original value
decreases to one quarter of its original value
increases four times to its original value

blocks.explanation: Coulomb's law: F ∝ 1/r² (faasle ke square ke ulat). Faasla aadha (10 m se 5 m) hua to force 2² = 4 guna ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.2 Which electric charge is possible on a particle?
(Kisi particle par kaun sa charge mumkin hai?)
blocks.explanation: Charge quantized (tukron mein) hota hai: q = Ne, jahan e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C aur N poora number hai. 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 2e, is liye mumkin hai; 2.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 1.56e poora multiple nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Asal mein aik se zyada option e ke poore multiple hain: option (c) 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁵ C (chhapai mein power saaf nahi) = 10⁴e hai. Sawal ka maqsad (b) 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 2e hai; (d) 6.02 × 10²³ C kisi particle ke liye na-mumkin had tak bara charge hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.3 Which diagram best represents the electric field lines around two oppositely charged particles? [Printed diagrams: (a) lines pointing inward into both the negative and the positive charge, not joined; (b) lines pointing outward from both charges, not joined; (c) lines joining the two charges with the arrows pointing into the positive charge; (d) lines joining the two charges, starting from the positive charge with the arrows ending on the negative charge.]
(Do mukhalif charges ke gird electric field lines ko kaun sa diagram sab se behtar dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Field lines positive charge se shuru ho kar negative charge par khatam hoti hain, aur mukhalif charges mein lines dono ko jorti hain (Fig. 9.8). Sirf diagram (d) yeh dikhata hai; (c) mein teer ulte hain.

blocks.prompt:
9.4 What is the work done on an election by potential difference of 100 volts?
(100 volt potential difference electron par kitna kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: W = qV = e × 100 V = 100 eV (= 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁷ J). 1 eV woh energy hai jo electron 1 V se guzar kar haasil karta hai. ("election" chhapai ki ghalti hai, electron hona chahiye.)

blocks.prompt:
9.5 The potential at a point situated at a distance of 50 cm from a charge of 50 μC is:
(50 μC charge se 50 cm door point par potential kitna hai?)

9.6 A ball of weight 0.1 N having a charge of 100 μC remained suspended between two oppositely charged horizontal metal plates. The electric intensity between the plates is:
(0.1 N wazan aur 100 μC charge wali gend do mukhalif charged ufuqi (horizontal) plates ke darmiyan latki rehti hai. Plates ke darmiyan electric intensity kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gend ruki rehti hai to electric force = wazan: qE = W, is liye E = W/q = 0.1 N/(100 × 10⁻⁶ C) = 1000 N C⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
9.7 A piece of wire has resistance of 4 Ω. It is doubled on itself so that its length becomes half but area of cross-section is doubled. Its resistance now will be:
(4 Ω wali taar ko dohra kar diya jaye: lambai aadhi aur cross-section ka area dugna. Ab resistance kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: R = ρL/A. Naya R = ρ(L/2)/(2A) = R/4 = 4 Ω/4 = 1 Ω.

blocks.prompt:
9.8 The current through a conductor is 3.0 A when it is attached across a potential difference of 6.0 V. How much power is used?
(6.0 V par conductor mein 3.0 A current hai. Kitni power istemal hoti hai?)

9.9 The algebraic sum of potential changes for a complete circuit is zero. It is the statement of:
(Mukammal circuit mein potential changes ka algebraic majmooa sifar hai. Yeh kis ka bayan hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kirchhoff ka doosra rule (loop rule): band circuit mein potential changes ka algebraic majmooa sifar hai; yeh energy ke conservation (bachao) se aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.10 The radius of curvature of the path of a charged particle in a uniform magnetic field is directly proportional to:
(Uniform magnetic field mein charged particle ke raste ka radius kis ke seedha mutanasib (directly proportional) hai?)

options.text: the flux density of the field

blocks.explanation: qvB = mv²/r se r = mv/(qB) = p/(qB), yani r momentum p ke seedha mutanasib hai (q aur B ke ulat). (Yeh chapter 10 ka topic hai.)

blocks.prompt:
9.1 How does a moving conductor like an aeroplane acquire charge as it flies through the air? Describe briefly.
(Hawa mein urta hua aeroplane jaisa conductor charge kaise haasil karta hai? Mukhtasar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ragar (friction) se: urte waqt jahaz ki metal body hawa ke molecules, gard, paani ke qatron aur barf ke zarron se ragarti hai. Electrons body aur in zarron ke darmiyan muntaqil (transfer) hote hain, is liye body par static charge aa jata hai jo us ki bahar ki metal surface par phail jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.2 Define electric intensity and electric potential.
(Electric intensity aur electric potential ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electric intensity: kisi point par rakhe unit positive charge par lagne wali force, E = F/q; unit N C⁻¹; vector.
Electric potential: unit positive charge ko infinity (la-mehdood faasle) se us point tak equilibrium mein laane ka kaam, V = W/q; unit volt; scalar.

blocks.prompt:
9.3 A battery is rated at 100 A h (ampere-hour). How much charge can this battery supply?
(Battery 100 A h (ampere-hour) rated hai. Yeh kitna charge de sakti hai?)

9.4 Is electron-volt a unit of potential difference or energy? Explain.
(Electron-volt potential difference ka unit hai ya energy ka? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electron-volt energy ka unit hai, potential difference ka nahi. Yeh woh energy hai jo electron 1 V potential difference se guzar kar haasil ya zaya karta hai: 1 eV = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)(1 V) = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J. Potential difference ka unit volt hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.5 A copper wire of length L has resistance R. It is stretched to double of its length. What will be the resistance of the new length of wire?
(L lambai ki copper taar ki resistance R hai. Isay khench kar dugni lambai kar diya jaye to nayi resistance kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation:
Volume wohi rehta hai, is liye lambai 2L ho to area A/2 ho jata hai.
R′ = ρ(2L)/(A/2) = 4ρL/A = 4R. Resistance chaar guna ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.6 Why does the resistance of a conductor rise with increase in temperature?
(Temperature barhne se conductor ki resistance kyun barhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Temperature barhne se lattice ke atoms zyada amplitude (phailao) se vibrate karte hain. Free electrons un se zyada baar takrate (collide karte) hain, un ka bahao zyada rukta hai, is liye resistance barh jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.7 Is the filament resistance lower or higher in a 500W-220V light bulb than in a 100 W-220V bulb?
(500 W-220 V bulb ke filament ki resistance 100 W-220 V bulb se kam hai ya zyada?)
blocks.explanation:
Kam. Aik hi voltage par R = V²/P.
500 W bulb: R = (220)²/500 = 96.8 Ω; 100 W bulb: R = (220)²/100 = 484 Ω.
Is liye 500 W bulb ke filament ki resistance kam hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.8 Why does resistance of a thermistor decrease as temperature increases?
(Temperature barhne se thermistor ki resistance kyun kam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermistor (NTC qisam) semiconductor oxides se banta hai. Temperature barhne se charge carriers (electrons aur holes) ko zyada energy milti hai aur zyada carriers azad ho kar chalne lagte hain. Zyada carriers yani kam resistance (negative temperature coefficient).

blocks.prompt:
9.9 Which materials can be used to construct Faraday's cage and why?
(Faraday cage kin materials se ban sakta hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Conductors jaise copper, aluminium ya steel (chadar ya jaali). In mein bohat se free electrons hote hain jo surface par aa kar aise tarteeb paate hain ke andar electric field sifar ho jata hai. Insulators mein free electrons nahi hote, is liye woh kaam nahi aate.

blocks.prompt:
9.1 Electric lines of force never cross each other. Why?
(Electric lines of force aik doosre ko kabhi nahi kaat'tin. Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Field line par kisi point ka tangent us point par electric field E ki simt (direction) batata hai. Agar do lines aik doosre ko kaat'tin to us point par do tangents, yani E ki do simtein hotin. Yeh na-mumkin hai kyunke aik point par resultant field ki sirf aik simt hoti hai. Is liye lines kabhi nahi kaat'tin.

blocks.prompt:
9.2 Is E necessarily zero inside a charged rubber balloon if the balloon is spherical? Assume that charge is distributed uniformly over the surface.
(Agar charged rubber balloon gol (spherical) ho aur charge surface par yaksaan phaila ho to kya andar E lazmi sifar hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Balloon ke andar us ke saath hum-markaz (concentric) gol Gaussian surface lein. Saara charge balloon ki surface par hai, is liye Gaussian surface ke andar koi charge nahi (Q = 0).
Gauss's law: φ = Q/ε₀ = 0. Symmetry ki wajah se E radial aur Gaussian surface par har jagah barabar hota, is liye E × 4πr² = 0, yani andar har jagah E = 0.
Is ke liye gol shakal aur yaksaan charge dono zaroori hain: rubber insulator hai, agar charge yaksaan na ho (ya shakal gol na ho) to andar field lazmi sifar nahi.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Gauss's law ka seedha nateeja: jitna charge band surface ke andar, utna hi flux. Andar charge sifar to flux sifar, aur gol symmetry mein flux sifar ka matlab field bhi sifar.

blocks.prompt:
9.3 Electrostatic force is 10³⁶ times stronger than gravitational force. Argue that our galaxy should be almost electrically neutral.
(Electrostatic force gravitational force se 10³⁶ guna taqatwar hai. Daleel dein ke hamari galaxy taqreeban electrically neutral honi chahiye.)
blocks.explanation:
Galaxy (sitare aur gas ke badal) gravity se jurri hai, jo electric force ke muqable mein bohat kamzor hai. Agar sitaron par aik hi qisam ka zara sa bhi net charge hota to un ki electric repulsion (dhakelne wali force), jo 10³⁶ guna taqatwar hai, gravity par ghalib aa kar galaxy ko bikher deti. Agar mukhalif charges hote to woh zor se aik doosre ko kheench kar jaldi neutral ho jate.
Galaxy gravity se qaim hai, is liye us ka net charge taqreeban sifar, yani woh taqreeban electrically neutral hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.4 An uncharged conducting hollow sphere is placed in the field of a positive charge q. What will be the net flux through the shell?
(Aik be-charge khokhla conducting sphere positive charge q ke field mein rakha hai. Shell mein se net flux kitna hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Sifar. Charge q shell ke bahar hai aur shell khud be-charge hai: field sirf us ki do taraf barabar negative aur positive charge induce karta hai jin ka majmooa sifar hai. Andar band charge sifar, is liye Gauss's law se φ = Q/ε₀ = 0. Jo line shell mein daakhil hoti hai woh nikal bhi jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.5 A potential difference is applied across the ends of a copper wire. What is the effect on the drift velocity of free elections by
(i) increasing the potential difference?
(ii) decreasing the length and the temperature of the wire?
(Copper taar ke siron par potential difference lagaya gaya hai. Free electrons ki drift velocity par kya asar hoga jab (i) potential difference barhaya jaye? (ii) taar ki lambai aur temperature kam kiya jaye?)
blocks.explanation:
I = nAv_d e aur I = V/R = VA/(ρL) se: v_d = V/(nρeL).
(i) V barhane se taar mein electric field E = V/L barhta hai, is liye drift velocity barhti hai (v_d ∝ V).
(ii) Lambai kam karne se E = V/L barhta hai, is liye v_d barhti hai. Temperature kam karne se atoms kam vibrate karte hain, takkarein (collisions) kam hoti hain (ρ kam), is liye v_d aur barhti hai. Yani (ii) mein bhi drift velocity barhti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Drift velocity ko aise samjhein: electrons par field dhakka deta hai aur atoms se takkarein rokti hain. Field tez (zyada V ya chhoti taar) ho ya takkarein kam (thandi taar) hon, dono surat mein electrons tez chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
9.6 Why the terminal potential difference of a battery decreases when the current drawn from it is increased?
(Battery se zyada current lene par us ka terminal potential difference kyun kam ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Battery ki apni internal resistance r hoti hai. Terminal potential difference V = E − Ir. Current I barhne se battery ke andar potential drop Ir (andar zaya hone wali energy fi unit charge) barhta hai, is liye terminal potential difference V kam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.1 Explain the electric potential and prove that electric field intensity is equal to the negative of potential gradient.
(Electric potential ki wazahat karein aur sabit karein ke electric field intensity potential gradient ka manfi (negative) hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Electric potential difference: do points A aur B ke darmiyan potential difference woh kaam hai jo unit positive charge ko A se B tak equilibrium mein le jane mein hota hai:
ΔV = V_B − V_A = W_AB/q = ΔU/q
Kisi point par electric potential: unit positive charge ko infinity (jahan V = 0) se us point tak equilibrium mein laane ka kaam: V = W/q. Unit: volt = J C⁻¹. Yeh scalar hai.
1 volt: 1 C positive charge ko do points ke darmiyan le jane mein 1 J kaam.

E = potential gradient ka manfi (saboot):
1. Do mukhalif charged parallel plates A aur B lein jin ke darmiyan uniform field E aur faasla d hai.
2. Positive charge q ko field ke khilaf A se B tak yaksaan velocity (equilibrium) se le jayein. Lagayi gayi force F = −qE, electric force qE ke ulat.
3. Kaam: W_AB = Fd = −qEd.
4. Potential difference: V_B − V_A = W_AB/q = −qEd/q = −Ed
5. Is liye E = −(V_B − V_A)/d = −ΔV/d
6. Bohat chhote faasle Δd ke liye: E = −ΔV/Δd
ΔV/Δd faasle ke saath potential ki tabdeeli ki sharah (rate) hai, jise potential gradient kehte hain. Yani electric intensity potential gradient ka manfi hai. Manfi nishan batata hai ke E kam hote potential ki taraf hota hai.
Unit: 1 V m⁻¹ = 1 N C⁻¹.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Potential ko unchai (height) ki tarah samjhein aur field ko dhalaan (slope) ki tarah: gend hamesha neeche ki taraf lurhakti hai, isi tarah E hamesha zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf hota hai. Isi liye formula mein manfi nishan hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.2 State and explain Kirchhoff's rules.
(Kirchhoff ke rules bayan karein aur wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kirchhoff ka pehla rule (point ya junction rule):
Circuit ke kisi point par milne wale tamam currents ka majmooa sifar hai: ΣI = 0.
Point ki taraf aane wala current positive aur door jaane wala negative liya jata hai. Agar I₁ aur I₂ point A ki taraf aayein aur I₃, I₄ door jayein to I₁ + I₂ + (−I₃) + (−I₄) = 0, yani I₁ + I₂ = I₃ + I₄.
Yani point ki taraf aane wale currents ka majmooa door jaane walon ke barabar hai. Yeh charge ke conservation (charge na banta hai na junction par jama hota hai) ka qanoon hai.

Kirchhoff ka doosra rule (loop rule):
Band circuit (loop) mein potential changes ka algebraic majmooa sifar hai: ΣV = 0.
Wazahat: aik loop lein jis mein cells E₁ aur E₂ (E₁ > E₂) aur resistors R₁, R₂ hain aur current I hai. Positive charge Q ko loop mein ghumayein:
- E₁ mein − se + : energy E₁Q milti hai
- R₁ mein current ki simt: IR₁Q zaya
- E₂ mein + se − : E₂Q zaya
- R₂ mein: IR₂Q zaya
Charge wapas shuru wali jagah aa jata hai, is liye kul energy ki tabdeeli sifar:
E₁Q − IR₁Q − E₂Q − IR₂Q = 0, yani E₁ − IR₁ − E₂ − IR₂ = 0
Yeh energy ke conservation ka qanoon hai.
Nishan (sign) ke qaide: cell − se + ki taraf paar karein to +E, + se − to −E; resistor current ki simt mein paar karein to −IR, current ke khilaf +IR.
Istemal: in rules se un complex circuits ke currents aur voltages maloom hote hain jo series/parallel se hal nahi hote.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pehla rule paani ke pipe ki tarah hai: jitna paani jorr par aata hai utna hi nikalta hai. Doosra rule pahar ke chakkar ki tarah hai: oopar neeche ho kar wapas usi jagah aao to kul unchai ki tabdeeli sifar.

blocks.prompt:
9.3 What is a Wheatstone bridge? Explain it with the help of a diagram.
(Wheatstone bridge kya hai? Diagram ki madad se wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Wheatstone bridge: chaar resistances ka circuit jis se null (balance) method ke zariye na-maloom resistance maloom ki jati hai.
Diagram (aise banayein): chaar resistances R₁, R₂, R₃ aur R₄ band shakal ABCDA mein: R₁ A se B, R₂ B se C, R₃ A se D aur R₄ D se C. Battery aur switch S ko A aur C ke darmiyan lagayein. Hassas (sensitive) galvanometer G ko B aur D ke darmiyan lagayein.
Kaam: S band karne par battery ka current A par taqseem hota hai aur aam taur par galvanometer mein current guzarta hai. Resistances ko itna badlein ke galvanometer koi deflection na dikhaye; ab bridge balanced hai.
Balance ki shart: G mein current sifar ho to B aur D ka potential barabar hai. R₁ aur R₂ mein aik hi current I₁ aur R₃ aur R₄ mein aik hi current I₂ hota hai, aur
R₁ par drop = R₃ par drop: I₁R₁ = I₂R₃ ... (1)
R₂ par drop = R₄ par drop: I₁R₂ = I₂R₄ ... (2)
(1) ko (2) se taqseem karein: R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄
Istemal: R₁, R₂, R₃ maloom hon to na-maloom resistance R₄ = R₂R₃/R₁.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Galvanometer ka zero hona hi balance ki pehchan hai: B aur D par potential barabar, is liye beech ki taar mein current nahi. Exam mein diagram mein A, B, C, D, chaaron resistances, battery, switch aur G zaroor label karein. Kitab ka apna saboot (Eq. 9.48-9.50) ghalat chhapa hai; oopar wala tareeqa sahi hai aur nateeja wohi R₁/R₂ = R₃/R₄ hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.4 What is a light dependent resistor (LDR)? How can this be used as ON-OFF switch for lighting?
(Light dependent resistor (LDR) kya hai? Isay roshni ke ON-OFF switch ke tor par kaise istemal kiya ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
LDR: aisa resistor jis ki resistance us par parne wali roshni ki shiddat (intensity) barhne se kam ho jati hai; isay photo resistor bhi kehte hain. Yeh cadmium sulphide jaise semiconductor se banta hai jo insulating plate par khaas design mein lagaya jata hai.
Usool: andhere mein material mein free electrons kam hote hain, resistance bohat zyada hoti hai. Roshni ke photons electrons ko energy de kar azad karte hain, conductivity barhti aur resistance kam hoti hai.
ON-OFF switch (khud-kar street light):
1. LDR ko fixed resistor (maslan 100 kΩ) ke saath series mein supply par laga kar voltage divider banayein; jorr B ko NPN transistor ke base (ya NOT gate) se jorein jo relay aur lamp chalata hai.
2. Andhere mein LDR ki resistance bohat zyada, is liye zyada voltage us par girta hai. B ka voltage itna ho jata hai ke transistor ON, relay lamp ko ON kar deta hai (shaam ko).
3. Din ki roshni mein LDR ki resistance bohat kam, us par voltage gir jata hai, transistor OFF aur lamp OFF (subah).
Yun roshni ki tabdeeli voltage ki tabdeeli ban kar khud-kar switch ka kaam karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.5 What is a potentiometer? Describe its working.
(Potentiometer kya hai? Is ka kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Potentiometer: woh aala jo null method se potential differences (emfs) ko durust naapta aur muqabla karta hai aur na-maloom resistance bhi maloom karta hai. Yeh naapi jane wali cell se koi current nahi leta.
Banawat: lambi yaksaan resistance wali taar AB (kul resistance R, lambai L) jis par sliding contact C (jockey) chalta hai. Emf E wali battery AB par lagi hoti hai.
Usool: yaksaan taar mein steady current I = E/R ho to taar ke saath potential drop lambai ke mutanasib hai: A aur C ke darmiyan V = rE/R = E l/L.
Na-maloom emf Eₓ naapna: cell Eₓ ko galvanometer G ke zariye A aur C ke darmiyan jorein, us ka positive terminal usi sire A se jo battery ke positive se jura hai. C ko itna sarkayein ke galvanometer zero dikhaye (null point). Tab Eₓ = A aur C ke darmiyan potential difference:
Eₓ = E r/R = E l/L
jahan l balancing length AC hai. Eₓ battery ke E se kam hona chahiye, warna null point nahi milta.
Do emfs ka muqabla: E₁ aur E₂ ke liye balancing lengths l₁ aur l₂ maloom karein: E₁/E₂ = l₁/l₂.
Faida: null point par cell se current nahi liya jata, is liye asal emf naapi jati hai; yeh aam voltmeter se zyada durust tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai potentiometer Wheatstone bridge ke usool par kaam karta hai; asal usool yeh hai ke yaksaan taar par potential drop lambai ke mutanasib hai (V ∝ l). Dono mein sirf null method mushtarik (common) hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.1 Two unequal point charges repel each other with a force of 0.4 N when they are 5.0 cm apart. Find the force which each exerts on the other when they are (a) 2.5 cm apart (b) 15.0 cm apart. [Ans: (a) 1.6 N (b) 0.04 N]
(Do na-barabar point charges 5.0 cm faasle par 0.4 N se aik doosre ko dhakelte hain. (a) 2.5 cm aur (b) 15.0 cm faasle par force maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): F₁ = 0.4 N at r₁ = 5.0 cm; r₂ = 2.5 cm; r₃ = 15.0 cm
Maloom karna hai (Required): F₂ aur F₃
Hal (Solution):
Coulomb's law F = kq₁q₂/r², charges wohi hain, is liye F ∝ 1/r².
F₂/F₁ = (r₁/r₂)²
(a) F₂ = 0.4 N × (5.0 cm/2.5 cm)² = 0.4 N × 4 = 1.6 N
(b) F₃ = 0.4 N × (5.0 cm/15.0 cm)² = 0.4 N × (1/9) = 0.044 N ≈ 0.04 N
Jawab (Answer): (a) 1.6 N (b) 0.044 N ≈ 0.04 N (dhakelne wali)

blocks.prompt:
9.2 A particle of charge +20 μC is placed between two parallel plates, 10 cm apart and having a potential difference of 0.5 kV between them. Calculate the electric field between the plates, and the electric force exerted on the charged particle. (Ans: 5 kN C⁻¹, 100 mN)
(+20 μC charge wala particle 10 cm door do parallel plates ke darmiyan hai jin par 0.5 kV potential difference hai. Plates ke darmiyan electric field aur particle par electric force maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): q = +20 μC = 20 × 10⁻⁶ C; d = 10 cm = 0.10 m; V = 0.5 kV = 500 V
Maloom karna hai (Required): E = ? ; F = ?
Hal (Solution):
E = V/d = 500 V/0.10 m = 5000 N C⁻¹ = 5 kN C⁻¹
F = qE = (20 × 10⁻⁶ C)(5000 N C⁻¹) = 0.1 N = 100 mN
Jawab (Answer): E = 5 kN C⁻¹; F = 100 mN

blocks.prompt:
9.3 The electron and proton in a hydrogen atom are separated (on the average) by a distance of approximately 5.3 × 10⁻¹¹ m. Find the ratio of the electric force and the gravitational force between the electron and proton in this state. (Ans: ≈ 2.3 × 10³⁹)
(Hydrogen atom mein electron aur proton ka ausat faasla 5.3 × 10⁻¹¹ m hai. Electric force aur gravitational force ki nisbat (ratio) maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): r = 5.3 × 10⁻¹¹ m; e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C; mₑ = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg; mₚ = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg; k = 9 × 10⁹ N m² C⁻²; G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²
Maloom karna hai (Required): Fₑ/F_g = ?
Hal (Solution):
Fₑ = ke²/r² = (9 × 10⁹)(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹)²/(5.3 × 10⁻¹¹)² = 8.2 × 10⁻⁸ N
F_g = G mₑ mₚ/r² = (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹)(9.1 × 10⁻³¹)(1.67 × 10⁻²⁷)/(5.3 × 10⁻¹¹)² = 3.6 × 10⁻⁴⁷ N
Nisbat (r² kat jata hai): Fₑ/F_g = ke²/(G mₑ mₚ) = (9 × 10⁹ × 2.56 × 10⁻³⁸)/(6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷)
= 2.304 × 10⁻²⁸/1.014 × 10⁻⁶⁷ = 2.27 × 10³⁹
Jawab (Answer): Fₑ/F_g ≈ 2.3 × 10³⁹ (electric force taqreeban 10³⁹ guna taqatwar)

blocks.prompt:
9.4 After a pleasant showering, a water droplet of mass 1.2 × 10⁻¹¹ kg is located in the air near the ground. An atmospheric electric field of magnitude 6.0 × 10³ N C⁻¹ points vertically downward in the vicinity of the water droplet. The droplet remains suspended at rest in the air. Find the electric charge on the droplet? (Ans: − 1.96 × 10⁻¹⁴ C)
(Barish ke baad 1.2 × 10⁻¹¹ kg ka paani ka qatra zameen ke qareeb hawa mein hai. 6.0 × 10³ N C⁻¹ ka electric field seedha neeche ki taraf hai. Qatra hawa mein ruka hua hai. Qatre par charge maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): m = 1.2 × 10⁻¹¹ kg; E = 6.0 × 10³ N C⁻¹ (downward); g = 9.8 m s⁻²
Maloom karna hai (Required): q = ?
Hal (Solution):
Qatra ruka hua hai, is liye electric force us ke wazan ke barabar hai: qE = mg (electric force oopar ki taraf honi chahiye).
|q| = mg/E = (1.2 × 10⁻¹¹ kg)(9.8 m s⁻²)/(6.0 × 10³ N C⁻¹) = 1.96 × 10⁻¹⁴ C
E neeche ki taraf hai magar force oopar chahiye, yani E ke ulat, is liye charge negative hai.
Jawab (Answer): q = −1.96 × 10⁻¹⁴ C

blocks.prompt:
9.5 An electron enters the region of a uniform electric filed, with vᵢ = 2.99 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ and E = 300 N C⁻¹. The horizontal length of the plates is 10.0 cm. Find the acceleration of the electron while it is in the electric field. How long will it take to pass through the field? (Ans: − 5.27 × 10¹³ m s⁻², 3.34 × 10⁻⁸ s)
(Electron vᵢ = 2.99 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ ke saath E = 300 N C⁻¹ wale uniform electric field mein daakhil hota hai. Plates ki ufuqi lambai 10.0 cm hai. Field mein electron ka acceleration aur field paar karne ka waqt maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): vᵢ = 2.99 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ (horizontal); E = 300 N C⁻¹; L = 10.0 cm = 0.100 m; e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C; m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg
Maloom karna hai (Required): a = ? ; t = ?
Hal (Solution):
Acceleration (force F = eE, E ke ulat kyunke electron negative hai):
a = eE/m = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)(300 N C⁻¹)/(9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) = 5.27 × 10¹³ m s⁻²
Simt E ke ulat, is liye a = −5.27 × 10¹³ m s⁻² (E ko positive maan kar).
Waqt: ufuqi velocity nahi badalti (force vertical hai), is liye
t = L/vᵢ = 0.100 m/(2.99 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹) = 3.34 × 10⁻⁸ s
Jawab (Answer): a = −5.27 × 10¹³ m s⁻²; t = 3.34 × 10⁻⁸ s

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Electron ka raasta projectile jaisa hai: ufuqi (horizontal) raftaar wohi rehti hai, is liye waqt sirf lambai/raftaar se nikalta hai; field sirf upar-neeche ka acceleration deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.6 A disc of 10 cm² area is placed in a vertical electric field E = 5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹. If the plane of disc makes an angle of 30° with the horizontal, determine the electric flux through the disc. (Ans: 250√3 N m² C⁻¹)
(10 cm² area ki disc vertical electric field E = 5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ mein rakhi hai. Disc ka plane horizontal se 30° ka zawiya banata hai. Disc mein se electric flux maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): A = 10 cm² = 10 × 10⁻⁴ m² = 1.0 × 10⁻³ m²; E = 5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹ (vertical); plane at 30° to the horizontal
Maloom karna hai (Required): φₑ = ?
Hal (Solution):
E vertical hai. Horizontal disc ka normal vertical hota hai; plane ko horizontal se 30° jhukane se normal bhi vertical se 30° jhuk jata hai, is liye θ (E aur vector area ke darmiyan) = 30°.
φₑ = EA cos θ = (5 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹)(1.0 × 10⁻³ m²) cos 30°
= 500 × (√3/2) = 250√3 N m² C⁻¹ ≈ 433 N m² C⁻¹
Jawab (Answer): φₑ = 250√3 N m² C⁻¹ ≈ 433 N m² C⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
9.7 A circular copper rod is 50 cm long and has 1 cm diameter. Find the resistance across its ends. What should be the side of square cross-section of a 50 cm long tungsten rod if its resistance is the same? [Resistivity of copper is 1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m and that of tungsten is 5.0 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m.] (Ans: left blank in the book)
(Copper ki gol rod 50 cm lambi aur 1 cm qutr (diameter) ki hai. Us ki resistance maloom karein. 50 cm lambi tungsten rod ke square cross-section ki side kitni ho ke resistance barabar ho?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): L = 50 cm = 0.50 m; d = 1 cm, r = 0.5 cm = 5 × 10⁻³ m; ρ_Cu = 1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m; ρ_W = 5.0 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m
Maloom karna hai (Required): Copper rod ki R; tungsten rod ki side a
Hal (Solution):
A_Cu = πr² = 3.1416 × (5 × 10⁻³ m)² = 7.85 × 10⁻⁵ m²
R = ρ_Cu L/A_Cu = (1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m)(0.50 m)/(7.85 × 10⁻⁵ m²) = 1.08 × 10⁻⁴ Ω
Tungsten rod, wohi R aur wohi L: R = ρ_W L/a²
a² = ρ_W L/R = (5.0 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m)(0.50 m)/(1.076 × 10⁻⁴ Ω) = 2.32 × 10⁻⁴ m²
a = √(2.32 × 10⁻⁴ m²) = 1.52 × 10⁻² m = 1.52 cm
Jawab (Answer): R = 1.08 × 10⁻⁴ Ω; tungsten rod ki side a = 1.52 cm

blocks.prompt:
9.8 The copper winding of an electric fan has a resistance of 50 Ω at 20 °C. After running for some time, the resistance becomes 58 Ω. How much is the increase in temperature of the winding? [For copper α = 0.0039 K⁻¹] (Ans: left blank in the book)
(Pankhe ki copper winding ki resistance 20 °C par 50 Ω hai. Kuch der chalne ke baad 58 Ω ho jati hai. Winding ka temperature kitna barha? [Copper ke liye α = 0.0039 K⁻¹])
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): R₁ = 50 Ω at 20 °C; R₂ = 58 Ω; α = 0.0039 K⁻¹
Maloom karna hai (Required): ΔT = ?
Hal (Solution):
α = (R_t − R_o)/(R_o t) mein shuru wali resistance ko reference le kar:
R₂ − R₁ = R₁ α ΔT
ΔT = (R₂ − R₁)/(R₁ α) = (58 Ω − 50 Ω)/(50 Ω × 0.0039 K⁻¹) = 8/0.195 = 41 K
Winding ka temperature taqreeban 41 K (41 °C) barhta hai, yani taqreeban 61 °C ho jata hai.
Jawab (Answer): ΔT ≈ 41 K (41 °C)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ka α 0 °C wali resistance R_o se define hota hai. Yahan R_o nahi diya, is liye 20 °C wali 50 Ω ko hi R_o maan kar hal kiya gaya hai (exam ka aam tareeqa). Agar pehle 0 °C ki resistance nikal kar karein to jawab taqreeban 44 K aata hai; farq is liye hai ke α thora sa reference temperature par munhasir hai.

blocks.prompt:
9.9 During an experiment a copper wire of 50 m long and 150 μm thick is hung vertically. Then a current of 1 A is passed across its ends for 50 s. Find the resistance of the wire and the heat dissipated during this process. [Resistivity of copper is 1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m.] (Ans: 4.8 GΩ, 2.4 × 10¹¹ J)
(Experiment mein 50 m lambi aur 150 μm moti copper taar latkayi gayi. Us mein 50 s tak 1 A current guzara gaya. Taar ki resistance aur paida hone wali heat maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): L = 50 m; thickness (diameter) d = 150 μm, r = 75 μm = 7.5 × 10⁻⁵ m; I = 1 A; t = 50 s; ρ = 1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m
Maloom karna hai (Required): R = ? ; heat H = ?
Hal (Solution):
A = πr² = 3.1416 × (7.5 × 10⁻⁵ m)² = 1.77 × 10⁻⁸ m²
R = ρL/A = (1.69 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m)(50 m)/(1.77 × 10⁻⁸ m²) = 47.8 Ω ≈ 48 Ω
H = I²Rt = (1 A)² × 47.8 Ω × 50 s = 2.39 × 10³ J ≈ 2.4 × 10³ J
Jawab (Answer): R ≈ 48 Ω; heat ≈ 2.4 × 10³ J

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab jawab 4.8 GΩ aur 2.4 × 10¹¹ J chhapti hai (chhoti power saaf nahi). Diye gaye data se resistance 47.8 Ω ≈ 48 Ω aur heat I²Rt ≈ 2.4 × 10³ J banti hai; 50 m copper taar ki resistance giga-ohms nahi ho sakti.

blocks.prompt:
9.10 The emf of a battery is 12 V. It is connected to a 3.6 Ω resistor. If the internal resistance of the battery is 0.2 Ω, what will be the terminal voltage across the battery? (Ans: 11.4 V)
(Battery ki emf 12 V hai aur yeh 3.6 Ω resistor se juri hai. Internal resistance 0.2 Ω ho to terminal voltage kitna hoga?)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya (Given): E = 12 V; R = 3.6 Ω; r = 0.2 Ω
Maloom karna hai (Required): V = ?
Hal (Solution):
I = E/(R + r) = 12 V/(3.6 Ω + 0.2 Ω) = 12/3.8 = 3.16 A
V = IR = 3.16 A × 3.6 Ω = 11.4 V
(Check: V = E − Ir = 12 V − 3.16 A × 0.2 Ω = 11.4 V)
Jawab (Answer): V = 11.4 V
